title: EFC — Flow, Entropy, and Spacetime Distortion in Cosmological Clusters
abstract: Describes how energy flow, entropy gradients, and grid-level resistance produce observable spacetime distortions in cosmological clusters, including lensing, dynamics, temperature asymmetries, and cluster morphology as emergent thermodynamic processes.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Cluster-scale spacetime distortion via entropy gradients

key_results: Spacetime distortion emerges from entropy gradients in cluster environments
Lensing effects explained through energy flow resistance without dark matter
Temperature asymmetries arise from thermodynamic flow imbalance
Cluster morphology predicted by entropy gradient topology
